notes: SD scores are z-scores vs each series' own history (typically since 1990), multiplied by a direction so +SD is bearish/expensive/risky for the composite, then capped at ±2.
Signal map: ≤−1.5 Strong Buy; ≤−0.5 Buy; ≤0.5 Hold; ≤1.5 Sell; else Strong Sell.
ICE BofA HY OAS is not redistributed (FRED Pre-Approval Required); Baa−10Y is the labeled substitute.
Price/Sales had no free redistributable source and has been removed. It is not scored.
The S&P price chart colors only composite readings saved in gauge_signal_history.json. Earlier prices are context. No historical signal is estimated.

price_chart.title: S&P 500 and the saved composite signal
price_chart.source_name: Robert J. Shiller, Irrational Exuberance data (monthly average price)
price_chart.disclaimer: Signal tracking starts on the first date a composite was saved. Prices before that are shown in gray because no composite history was saved, and none is estimated. The line is Shiller's monthly average S&P price as first stored here, not a daily close and not an intraday quote. Stored months are not rewritten when Shiller revises them. Colored marks are saved gauge readings at the price then on file. This chart illustrates those readings. It is not a backtest of strategy returns.
